reason: The frozen protocol specified the economic features and success rules but not low-level missing-data, port-matching, and ridge-tuning mechanics.
portwatch_information_timing: Use PortWatch month t for a forecast whose BLS price origin is month t. The BLS origin-month import-price observation is released during t+1, while PortWatch is updated weekly, so completed PortWatch month t is available by the forecast issue time. This remains pseudo-real-time because PortWatch historical revisions are not vintaged.
pressure_transform: For each raw PortWatch metric, shock_t = -(log1p(metric_t) - log1p(metric_t-12)). Positive means weaker maritime activity than a year earlier.
census_exposure: 2017-2018 average/summed vessel import value shares relative to each HS chapter's total vessel import value, fixed before PortWatch begins.
country_mapping: Exact Census country-name mapping to the 14 frozen ISO3 origins.
us_port_mapping: Deterministic manual aliases for known combined ports plus exact normalized-name matches. No unconstrained fuzzy match is accepted. Known wrong-state same-name matches are rejected.
missing_portwatch_months: Never interpret a missing country/port observation as zero. Reweight over available shocks only when at least 80% of that product's matched fixed exposure is observed; preserve the magnitude of the product's matched fixed exposure rather than renormalizing to 100% of total imports.
route_feature: For each fixed Census country-port route, route shock is the arithmetic mean of the corresponding origin export shock and US destination-port import shock. Aggregate using fixed route vessel-value shares.
model: Pooled ridge residual correction of frozen GSCPI-model forecast errors. At each forecast origin and horizon, training rows are restricted to targets whose target_end <= current origin.
ridge_tuning: At each forecast origin, choose alpha by a blocked inner validation using the last 6 unique eligible training origins, fit on earlier origins, then refit on all eligible training rows. Require at least 12 unique eligible training origins before issuing a PortWatch-corrected forecast.
predictors: Eight frozen PortWatch pressure features at lags 0-3 plus matched_route_exposure_coverage once.
primary_comparison: Frozen GSCPI model M1 versus M1 plus PortWatch residual correction.
diagnostic_ablation: Also compute an intercept-only rolling residual-bias correction to determine whether any apparent gain is merely generic forecast-bias correction rather than PortWatch information.
bootstrap: Paired moving-block bootstrap over forecast-origin months, block length 6, preserving all products within a selected month; 5000 draws.
data_quality_origin_rule: Before joining to price outcomes, exclude forecast-origin months where fewer than 80% of the 18 products have complete PortWatch predictors. This is based only on PortWatch feature availability; it primarily removes 2020 months affected by downloader/API gaps.
